label: sec:mw-learned
title: Learned Rewriting
html:
The rules of Table 6 carry side conditions on widths. A rule is applied only if its side condition is entailed by the width constraints of the formula. We focus mostly on extensions, which these rules simplify or eliminate whenever the side conditions on the widths enable it. The rules with source [35] are taken from the axioms of ParaBit. These axioms are bidirectional, but, as in Section 5.1, we only take one direction of each.

The extract rules correspond to the axioms of ParaBit that propagate a modular reduction into the operands of an operator. Rules sext-zext and sext-sub-zext turn a sign extension into a zero extension when the sign bit is known to be zero, and the sext-bit rules replace the sign extension of a single bit by a linear term. This matters because the translation of exts​ involves a case split on the most significant bit and two additional powers of two.
